serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: As they were getting closer to leaving this haunted place, every object in their proximity went flying. 
You: Boy and girl instinctively ducked and covered their heads when faced with a barrage of flying chairs and medical equipment.
You: They got lucky. All of these objects missed and only the man waiting for them made a sound as if something struck him.
You: Boy waited for some gap, a moment when they could safely get out and when such an opportunity presented itself he took the hand of his friend one more time and pulled her behind him. 
You: As soon as they went through the door he felt something strong grabbing his arm. It was the man.
You: ‘We need to get out of here! My car is nearby!’
You: During their walk to the car man was scolding them, but teenagers didn’t mind. They were just glad that everything was over.
You: Man promised to drive them back to the city and they agreed.
You: While being in the car, the girl, having nothing better to do, took out the paper that she took. It was a patient card of someone called Bart Novak. 
You: He was described as a highly aggressive individual, a psychopath and a pathological liar. His involvement in many disappearances around the area brought attention of the police, but they had no proof. That’s why he was sent for a ‘permanent stay in a mental institution.’
You: Picture was attached to the card...
You: ‘Mister, are we going the right way? I never saw these woods before.’ Said the boy.
You: The moment when the boy asked his question, the girl realized something horrible.
You: The man in the picture…{{wi}} was the same man that they met before going to hospital… {{wi}} and that man was the one giving them a ride right now…
You: Cold sweat was running down the girl's back and fear paralized her…
You: ‘Don’t worry kids’ said the man. ‘We are going exactly where I want…’
Bot: …
You: To this day…{{wi}} No one saw them again…
Bot: …
Bot: I have a question.
You: Yes? 
Bot: You told me this is a real story, right?
You: R-right.
Bot: If no one saw them again, how do you know this story? 
Bot: Don’t tell me…{{wi}} Are you Bart Novak?!
You: No! Of course not!
Bot: But he was a pathological liar, if you were him, you would never tell me the truth…
Bot: Am I…
#bot.Expression.Sad
#bot.Expression.VeryShock
Bot: Next?
You: No! People always say that horror stories happened for real, because it makes them scarier!

#bot.Expression.VeryShock
Bot: So that was also a lie…
Bot: What are you going to do to me now that I know your secret? R-rape and kill me?
You: Oh come on! Don’t joke like that!
You: It’s just a story, fiction, fabrication. I just wanted to scare you!
#bot.Expression.VeryShock
Bot: O-ok, I get it. 
Bot: So the point of horror stories is to pretend to be a serial killer to make people scared of you.
You: No! 
After a few minutes of arguing I finally explained to her the whole idea of a horror story…
What a pain…
